text:
leah_ae: AcmePacific asks for concrete logging evidence for the POC: admin audit samples, 12-month retention proof, and SIEM export steps. Can we turn around a short packet by EOD?
omar_security: We should include a one-paragraph control summary (encryption, immutability, RBAC, manifests). Hosted-only for POC, right?
leah_ae: Yes hosted only. Short attestation + samples + export snippet is perfect.
ben_sre: I'll produce sanitized JSONL samples and an example curl to fetch audit events. We retain audit data in immutable buckets with Object Lock + KMS. Monthly signed manifests are generated.
ben_sre: sample logs (JSONL):
{"timestamp":"2025-11-02T07:12:10Z","event":"api_key.create","actor":"user:carla@acmep","target":"org:acmep","request_id":"req_01","ip":"198.51.100.10"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-08T16:33:04Z","event":"role.change","actor":"user:ops@acmep","target":"role:admin","request_id":"req_02"}
ben_sre: example export curl (redacted):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" 'https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/admin/audit?org_id=acmep&start=2025-11-01&end=2025-11-30' -o acmep-audit.json
zoe_pre-sales: I'll draft the attestation wording and the control bullets. Omar, can you sign off on security phrasing?
omar_security: Yes. Include IAM roles (audit_reader, audit_writer, audit_admin), IdP deprovisioning for offboarding, and that archived objects are read-only and encrypted with customer/Redwood KMS keys.
sysbot: Uploaded manifest: s3://redwood-audit/manifests/2025-11.manifest.sig
leah_ae: Great — thanks. Zoe, please send the bundle to AcmePacific and cc me. We'll offer a temporary live export window if they want to ingest.
